# `nlink-lab wait-for`

<!-- generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit by hand -->

```text
Wait for a service or condition inside a lab node

Usage: nlink-lab wait-for [OPTIONS] <LAB> <NODE>

Arguments:
  <LAB>
          Lab name

  <NODE>
          Node name

Options:
      --tcp <TCP>
          Wait for TCP port (e.g., "127.0.0.1:8080" or just "8080" for localhost)

      --exec <EXEC_CMD>
          Wait for command to succeed (exit 0)

      --file <FILE>
          Wait for file to exist

  -t, --timeout <TIMEOUT>
          Timeout in seconds (default: 30)
          
          [default: 30]

      --interval <INTERVAL>
          Poll interval in milliseconds (default: 500)
          
          [default: 500]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Wait for a service or condition inside a lab node

Usage: nlink-lab wait-for [OPTIONS] <LAB> <NODE>

Arguments:
  <LAB>
          Lab name

  <NODE>
          Node name

Options:
      --tcp <[IP:]PORT>
          Wait for TCP port (e.g., "127.0.0.1:8080" or just "8080" for localhost). With --exec or --file too, all must hold, within one --timeout

      --exec <EXEC_CMD>
          Wait for command to succeed (exit 0)

      --file <FILE>
          Wait for file to exist

  -t, --timeout <DURATION>
          How long to wait for all of them
          
          [default: 30s]

  -i, --interval <DURATION>
          How often to probe
          
          [default: 500ms]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
